name: Zibiah
title: Mother of King Joash of Judah
summary: Zibiah (also written Zibiah of Beersheba) was the mother of King Joash of Judah. She was married to King Ahaziah, and after his death her son Joash was hidden in the temple for six years to avoid Queen Athaliah's attempt to wipe out the royal line. Zibiah played an important role as the mother of the king who restored the worship of the Lord in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as the mother of King Joash
keyEvents.description: Zibiah of Beersheba is identified as the mother of Joash, king of Judah, in the introduction to his reign.

keyEvents.title: Joash Hidden from Athaliah
keyEvents.description: After Athaliah's attempt to wipe out the entire royal line, Zibiah's son Joash was rescued and hidden in the house of the Lord for six years by Jehosheba and the priest Jehoiada.

keyEvents.title: Joash Crowned King
keyEvents.description: After six years in hiding, Joash son of Sibah was anointed and crowned king over Judah by the high priest Jehoiada, and Athaliah was overthrown.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Sibah from Beersheba is also mentioned in 2 Chronicles as the mother of King Joash, who reigned for forty years in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Joash Restores the Temple
keyEvents.description: Joash son of Sibah initiated a major restoration of the Lord's temple, inspired by the guidance of priest Jehoiada, and restored proper worship in Judah.
